office_does: Grays Harbor PUD commissioners appoint the general manager, set electricity rates, approve budgets and set policy for the public utility; District 3 is nominated by district but elected by voters of the whole PUD.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Commissioner Jon Martin, appointed in 2021 and elected in 2022, is the only candidate. He submitted no voters'-guide statement.

candidates.summary: Grays Harbor PUD commissioner for District 3 since his 2021 appointment and board president; former Ocean Shores city council president. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed in 2021 to replace Russ Skolrood; elected unopposed in 2022 [S2][S4]
As board president, backed a 3% rate increase in 2025 and a no-increase 2026 budget that used reserves [S6][S7]
Wrote in 2026 that small modular nuclear reactors could add reliable power, with cost questions unresolved [S8]
